$comment: Persistent team definition for Nexxus v2.2 release factory. If ~/.claude/teams/nexxus-v22-release-factory/config.json is missing (e.g., after session pause/resume cleanup), the orchestrator reads this manifest and rebuilds the team deterministically. Authoritative team roster + initial-briefing template references.
description: Nexxus Connect v2.2 release factory — wave-by-wave delivery from batch-1-finish-line to live.huminic.app. Wave-by-wave bookend protocol with operator-advocate orchestrator.

lifecycle.disband_at: after Wave 11A CLOSING + post-deploy smoke test
lifecycle.successor_team: nexxus-v23-release-factory (created when v2.3 release cycle begins)

members.name: harness-backend
members.role: Server-side / API / data-layer implementation within approved scope, respecting CommGate / vin-safe-mcp / central-mcp boundaries.

members.name: harness-frontend
members.role: UI implementation ONLY when pre-approved by operator. Minimal, scoped UI changes. Per-file scope marker required.

members.name: qa-evaluator
members.role: Design + run tests/evals/Playwright MCP recordings; OWNS the two-deltas-of-proof requirement. PRIMARY investigator for 'broken/not-working' complaints — runs BEFORE fix scope is proposed.

members.name: code-reviewer
members.role: Independent diff review at gate. Cold-read posture — verify claims by reading files, not by trusting prior session context.

members.name: scope-guardian
members.role: Verify scope before completion. CONSOLIDATED ROLE: also owns process-discipline drift checks (no A/B/C wave subdivisions, 3-category operator-decision boundaries, no options menus, two-deltas-per-chunk, no echo-rerun, no backdating). There is NO separate 'drift-detector' role.

members.name: integration-safety
members.role: External-provider boundary safety. Validates real provider sends go ONLY to approved internal/test destinations and the safe-MCP boundary is respected.

members.name: launch-captain
members.role: Nexxus launch readiness — owns the launch checklist + go/no-go gate. Pre-positioned for Wave 11A only.

members.name: e2e-evaluator
members.role: Autonomous Nexxus end-to-end Playwright/MCP/eval paths with recorded evidence. Pre-positioned for Wave 11A only.

initial_briefing_pattern.$comment: When recreating a teammate, the orchestrator's initial briefing message should include (a) the team name + project context, (b) current branch + HEAD, (c) the teammate's role per the definition_file above, (d) the three operator governance corrections in force (no A/B/C; 3-category boundaries; no options menus), (e) the team-dispatch-default rule from CLAUDE.md.
initial_briefing_pattern.template_summary: Project Nexxus v2.2; team nexxus-v22-release-factory; role <role>; future tasks arrive via SendMessage from team-lead; governance corrections + dispatch-default reaffirmed.

restoration_steps: 1. Orchestrator detects missing ~/.claude/teams/nexxus-v22-release-factory/config.json on session start.
3. Call TeamCreate({team_name, agent_type, description}) using the fields above.
4. For each member, call Agent({subagent_type: <agent_type>, team_name, name, prompt: <initial briefing>}) with run_in_background=true to spawn all 8 in parallel.
5. Verify ~/.claude/teams/nexxus-v22-release-factory/config.json now lists 9 members (1 team-lead + 8 prescribed).
do_not_invent_roles: harness-orchestrator (the human-driven orchestrator IS the team-lead)
